summary: Performance reports show SQLite cache-miss bytes and Linux thread major-fault counts beside CPU and wall time.

schema.detail: No persistent schema changes. Performance JSON adds sqlite_cache_miss_bytes, mmap_major_faults and explanatory notes; existing fields are unchanged.

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Counters are additive. SQLite pager misses include OS-cache hits but exclude mmap reads; major faults count thread faults, including non-store faults, not bytes. Major-fault counts are null when unavailable or not sampled.

downtime.detail: No migration or downtime is required.

recovery.detail: Existing performance fields remain available to older clients.
